author: yassinyl
description: Bootimus is a modern PXE and HTTP boot server with embedded iPXE bootloaders, ISO booting, automatic kernel and initrd extraction, client management, diagnostic tools, Windows SMB deployment, and a web administration interface.
tagline: Modern PXE and HTTP Boot Server

tips.before_install:
IMPORTANT - PXE NETWORK CONFIGURATION

Bootimus requires a macvlan network connected directly
to your physical LAN interface.

The macvlan network is NOT created automatically.

After installing Bootimus, create the macvlan network:

sudo docker network create -d macvlan \
  --subnet=192.168.178.0/24 \
  --gateway=192.168.178.1 \
  --ip-range=192.168.178.111/32 \
  -o parent=eth0 \
  bootimus_lan

Then connect it to Bootimus:

sudo docker network connect \
  --ip 192.168.178.111 \
  bootimus_lan \
  bootimus-server

Then restart Bootimus:

sudo docker restart bootimus-server

Web UI:

http://192.168.178.111:8081

IMPORTANT:

192.168.178.111 is only an example.

Replace it with an unused IP address from your own LAN.

Replace 192.168.178.0/24 with your LAN subnet.

Replace 192.168.178.1 with your LAN gateway.

Replace eth0 with your physical LAN interface if necessary.

The IP configured in BOOTIMUS_SERVER_ADDR must match
the IP assigned to Bootimus through the macvlan network.

Do not disable your existing DHCP server.

Bootimus ProxyDHCP works alongside an existing DHCP server
such as a FRITZ!Box.
tips.after_install:
Bootimus has been installed.

PXE requires an additional macvlan network.

Create the macvlan network:

sudo docker network create -d macvlan \
  --subnet=192.168.178.0/24 \
  --gateway=192.168.178.1 \
  --ip-range=192.168.178.111/32 \
  -o parent=eth0 \
  bootimus_lan

Connect it to Bootimus:

sudo docker network connect \
  --ip 192.168.178.111 \
  bootimus_lan \
  bootimus-server

Restart Bootimus:

sudo docker restart bootimus-server

Web UI:

http://192.168.178.111:8081

Replace 192.168.178.111 with the unused LAN IP
assigned to your Bootimus macvlan network.
